requirement_points.text: A GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute type exists and can be applied to a partial class declaration.
The source generator recognizes GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute on a partial class that implements IMessagePackFormatter<T> and emits the formatter implementation for that class.
The generator emits the formatter for T when T is declared in a referenced assembly that does not reference the MessagePack package.
The generator accepts a partial class declaration for the formatter that has no body and still emits the implementation.
The generator supports specifying property keys and union settings for T through a mechanism that does not require the assembly defining T to reference MessagePack.

plants.description: The guard now rejects only the zero-interface case, so a formatter that implements more than one IMessagePackFormatter<T> (or an inherited duplicate) silently proceeds and an arbitrary interface, formatterInterfaces[0], is used to build the model. The 'exactly one' contract is no longer enforced.
